question: The pensions payable to or in respect of the officers and servants of the Supreme Court are charged upon ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Consolidated Fund of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Consolidated Fund of India** is the **main fund **of the government and **all revenues** received by the government, **loans** raised by the government, and money received in **repayment of loans** form part of this fund.
